title: QFT Replacement in Quantum Linear Key Recovery
summary: The FFT accelerates classical linear key-recovery attacks, but whether the QFT can effectively replace it in quantum linear attacks remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether, in quantum linear key-recovery attacks, the FFT step used to speed up classical linear key-recovery attacks can be effectively replaced by the quantum Fourier transform (QFT). Prior quantum linear attacks left this replacement unresolved, and carrying it out is described as difficult.

scope.domain: Quantum linear cryptanalysis adapting classical FFT-accelerated key recovery to the QFT.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine whether the classical FFT acceleration step can be effectively replaced by the QFT in quantum linear key-recovery attacks.

citations.label: Quantum Linear Key-recovery Attacks Using the QFT

progress.summary: The source presents replacing the FFT with the QFT as a natural but difficult step and states that previous quantum linear attacks left it open.
citation_labels: André Schrottenloher et al., Quantum Linear Key-recovery Attacks Using the QFT
